name: Tennis Software
author: seosbg

sections.description:
Tennis Club Management Software! User-Friendly Interface, 36 Languages, Download Daily Reports, Track Reserved Slots, Easily Manage and Navigate All Courts, Page displays user reservations for the day. Statistics for the number of reservations and profit, Add members, Online Reservations

Tennis Software is a plugin for embedding iframe content based on user-specific codes. – https://softwaretennis.com/
sections.installation:
Install via Plugins > Install New

  1. Search for “Tennis Software”
  2. Click the “Install Now” link
  3. Click “Activate Plugin”

Via ZIP / FTP

  1. Unzip the ZIP file and drop the folder straight into your wp-content/plugins directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

Go to “Tennis Software” in the admin menu to configure your settings. Use the generated shortcode to embed content.

Can I change the colors?

Yes, you can customize the body, background, and text colors from the settings page.
